name: Poke Milkweed
desc: Poke Milkweed (Asclepias exaltata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asclepias exaltata is a species of flowering plant in the dogbane family, native to eastern North America. Poke Milkweed's green and white flowers bloom from late spring to early summer.
